title: Vintage UCLA Bruins Rose Bowl Hat Navy Blue Adjustable Cap Embroidered Logo
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Fan Apparel & Souvenirs:College-NCAA
descriptionText: The Vintage UCLA Bruins Rose Bowl Hat Navy Blue Adjustable Cap is a nostalgic piece of fan apparel perfect for football enthusiasts. The embroidered logo on the cap featuring the UCLA Bruins adds a touch of team spirit to any outfit. Made by Nissin in the Philippines, this adjustable cap comes in a classic navy blue color, making it versatile for various occasions. Perfect for Ole Miss Rebels fans looking for a unique and stylish addition to their collection.
